notes: Draft ruleset for residential use in NON-CONGESTED municipal-corporation areas of Maharashtra under UDCPR 2020. EVERY regulatory value below is pending verification against the UDCPR text (Table 6-G and related regulations) by a licensed architect/liaison. Do not show to clients.

params.description: FSI entitlement by front road width (m): basic FSI (by right), premium FSI (on payment), TDR loading (purchased rights). maxRoadWidthM: null = no upper bound.
params.source: UDCPR 2020, Table 6-G (residential, non-congested) — TO BE VERIFIED

params.description: Basic FSI for residential plots of 1000 sq m and above (including amalgamated plots), irrespective of road width
params.source: UDCPR 2020 large-plot provision — TO BE VERIFIED

params.description: Ancillary area FSI available on payment of premium, as a fraction of the FSI in the development permission (residential). NOT included in v0.1 scenario totals; recorded for the report's notes.
params.source: UDCPR 2020 ancillary-FSI provision — TO BE VERIFIED

params.description: Working assumption: saleable area as a fraction of built-up area (loading/efficiency), user-overridable
Working assumption for redevelopment: rehab built-up area as a multiple of existing built-up area (free-sale homes for existing members, incl. the customary area increase)
